text:
The outage at the Ruvenna data centre last spring was caused by a software update error, the company confirmed at a press briefing I attended.

Dr. Maren Teliq, Chief Infrastructure Officer at Ruvenna Data Services, told reporters the failure began at 02:14 on 11 April, when a scheduled update ran. Service was not fully restored until the early evening. Downtime totalled about 9 hours and 40 minutes and affected roughly 1,300 client systems.

Dr. Teliq pointed to the company's Post-Incident Review, RDS-PIR-0411, which I was shown at the briefing. It traces the fault to a defective configuration script in the update. "The cause was the update, and we have said so plainly," she told the room.
